scope: Priority token contracts. Activity and volume cover each token's selected pool.
combination: All supplied filters must match. Missing or invalidated measures never satisfy a numeric filter, including a zero threshold.
ordering: Numeric sorts descend, with unavailable values last. Ties use name and address. Depth measures remain separate.
